archetypes.name: dyn-step2b-contract
archetypes.rationale: Step 2b wrapper output ordering is sensitive after helper extraction.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the extracted Step 2b drafter helpers for behavior drift from the prior monolithic flow. Focus on pause-save gating, DRAFTER_NEXT_ACTION delimiter emissions, dirty-tree recovery ordering, Codex sidecar append timing, and inline-fallback stdout ordering. Check that helper boundaries did not move side effects across validation, launch, structure-read, or dirty-tree gates. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
